test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding river Ganga is correct?

options.text: Ghaghara is a tributary coming from peninsular uplands.
Yamuna is a right bank tributary meets the Ganga at Allahabad.
The length of the Ganga is over 5000 km.
Betwa is a tributary of river Ganga rising from the Himalayas.

solution:
The correct answer is **Yamuna is a right bank tributary meets the Ganga at Allahabad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**River Ganga

__
 
• It originates in the Himalaya Mountains at Gomukh, the terminus of the Gongotri Glacier. Here, it is known as the Bhagirathi.
 
• It cuts through the Central and the Lesser Himalayas in narrow gorges.
 
• At Devprayag, the Bhagirathi meets the Alaknanda; hereafter, it is known as the Ganga.
 
• The river has a length of 2,525 km. *(Option 3 Incorrect)__*
 
• It is shared by Uttarakhand (110 km) and Uttar Pradesh (1,450 km), Bihar (445 km) and West Bengal (520 km).
 
• The river finally discharges itself into the Bay of Bengal near Sagar Island.
 
• Left tributaries: Gomti, Ghaghara, Gandak, Burhi Gandak, Koshi, Mahananda, Ramganga, Garra.
 
• Right tributaries: Yamuna, Sone, Punpun, Damodar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Yamuna:

__
 
• ​Originates from Yamunotri Glacier.
 
• Passes from states- Uttarakhand, Himachal Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Delhi.
 
• Merge in Ganga at Praygraj(Allahabad). ***(Option 2 correct)**__*
 
• The Yamuna is the second-largest tributary river of the Ganga and the longest tributary.
 
• Left tributaries of Yamuna are Tons, Hindon, Hanuman Ganga, Sasur, Khaderi.
 
• Right tributaries of Yamuna are Giri, Baghain, Chambal, Betwa, Sindh, Ken.
 
• Length of river 1,376 km. 

**River Ghaghara :**

__
 
• Ghaghara River is also called the Gogra, Ghaghara or Ghagra, Nepali Kauriala or Manchu or the Karnali.
 
• However, the literal meaning of the river is ' holy water from the sacred mountain',
 
• The term Karnali also means "Turquoise River" and is a transboundary perennial river that originates on the Tibetan plateau. *(Option 1 Incorrect)__*
 
• The Karnali is called K'ung-ch'iao Ho in Chinese.
 
• This river near Manasarovar cuts through the Himalayas in Nepal on its way to the convergence with the Sarda River at Brahmaghat in India where it forms the Ghaghara River.
 
• The Ghaghara River is a major left-bank tributary of the Ganges.
 
• It is the longest and largest river in Nepal with a length of around 507 km and one of the largest affluent of the Ganges.

River Betwa:

__
 
• It originates from the Vindhyachal Ranges of Raisen district in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Betwa is an important tributary of the river Yamuna. ***(Option 4 Incorrect)**__*
 
• The length of the river Betwa is around 590 Km.
 
• Important cities on the bank of the river Betwa are Vidisha, Sanchi, and Orcchaa.
 
• Raj Ghat Dam is situated on the river Betwa.
 
• Ken-Betwa river interlinking project is the proposed project to transfer the surplus water from River Ken to Betwa in order to meet the water needs of the drought-prone Bundelkhand Region of Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh.
